verdict.rationale: First-party docs state you can choose the region per sandbox or set a project default, across iad1, sfo1, cle1 and cdg1. A changelog entry says Sandbox is now available in all regions. This covers choosing where sandboxes, and therefore their data, run. Missing for 10: an explicit data-residency guarantee (e.g. that snapshots, persistent state and Drives stay in the chosen region); a clear current region list, since the pricing page's four regions differ from the 'all regions' changelog; independent or hands-on corroboration.
